verses.text: Keep on loving each other as brothers and sisters.
Do not forget to welcome strangers into your home. Some people who did this have welcomed angels without knowing it.
Remember those who are in prison, as if you were in prison with them. Remember those who are treated badly, as if you were suffering with them.
Everyone should respect marriage, and husband and wife must be faithful to each other. God will judge those who sin sexually and those who cheat on their marriage.
Do not love money. Be happy with what you have, because God has said, "I will never leave you. I will never turn my back on you."
So we can say with courage, "The Lord helps me. I will not be afraid. What can people do to me?"
Remember your leaders, who taught you God's word. Think about how good their lives turned out, and copy their faith.
Jesus Christ is the same yesterday, today and forever.

Do not let all kinds of strange teachings lead you away. It is good for our hearts to be made strong by God's kindness, not by rules about food. Those rules have never helped the people who follow them.
We have an altar, and those who serve in the old tent of worship have no right to eat from it.
The high priest takes the blood of animals into the Most Holy Place as an offering for sin, but the bodies of those animals are burned outside the camp.
In the same way, Jesus suffered outside the city gate, to make the people holy through his own blood.
So let us go out to him, outside the camp, and accept the same shame he suffered.
Here on earth we do not have a city that lasts forever. We are looking for the city that is still to come.
So through Jesus, let us always offer praise to God as our sacrifice. Let our lips praise his name and show that we belong to him.
And do not forget to do good and to share with others, because God is pleased with sacrifices like these.
Obey your leaders and do what they say. They watch over your souls, and they must answer to God for their work. Help them do it with joy and not with sadness, because that would not help you.
Pray for us. We are sure our conscience is clear, and we want to live in an honest way in everything.
I especially beg you to pray, so that God will bring me back to you soon.
God gives peace. He brought our Lord Jesus back from death, the great Shepherd of the sheep, through the blood of the covenant that lasts forever.
May God give you every good thing you need to do what he wants. May he work in us what pleases him, through Jesus Christ. Glory to Jesus forever and ever! Amen.
Brothers and sisters, please listen patiently to these words of encouragement, because I have only written you a short letter.
I want you to know that our brother Timothy has been let out of prison. If he comes soon, I will bring him with me when I come to see you.
Say hello to all your leaders and to all God's people. The believers from Italy send you their greetings.
May God's kindness be with you all. Amen.
